species.name: White bass
why: Water 67°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–24 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 35 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 55 ft, so fish stay above it.
East wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the west shore: try the wind-blown banks.
